official.credit: approximately top 55% of year and region
official.distinction: approximately top 20% of year and region
official.high_distinction: approximately top 3% of year and region
official.prize: generally no more than 1 in 300 within region and year group
official.note: Official raw-score cutoffs vary by year and region. The app must use paper-year WA cutoffs when verified; otherwise label the result as an estimate.

practice_estimate_wa.label: WA practice estimate — not an official AMT cutoff
practice_estimate_wa.rationale: Training-only WA estimate for immediate feedback when no official paper-year WA raw cutoff is verifiable. Distinction is centred around the low 80s and High Distinction from about 85, based on the learner's prior WA result context. The UI must label this as an estimate and replace it with verified paper-year WA cutoffs whenever available.
